title: Model-Aware Generation of Safety-Critical Scenes for Robust End-to-End Driving via Distilled Planner Surrogates

control_signal.value: A single collision objective against a specific target planner; attack types are not specified by hand but emerge from the search. Each scene is paired with a geometrically solved safe escape trajectory.

control_mechanism.value: Gradient-based optimization of an adversary's BEV trajectory through a differentiable surrogate (frozen planning head plus small adapter), with a quality-diversity search; surviving scenes rendered and used to fine-tune the planner.

base_model.value: Surrogate adapter (0.83 M parameters) over the target planner's frozen head (SparseDrive or DiffusionDrive); MagicDriveV2 renders six-camera video; no learned generative traffic model.

datasets.value: nuScenes train split for base scenes and renderer; NeuroNCAP (closed-loop), Challenger (open-loop replay) and nuScenes val for evaluation.

metrics.value: NeuroNCAP score and collision rate (CR); Challenger open-loop collision rate and L2; clean nuScenes collision rate and L2; surrogate recall on real collisions.

controllability_evidence.value: Closed-loop collision rate falls from 28.0% to 12.2% (SparseDrive) and 37.5% to 19.2% (DiffusionDrive); cross-planner transfer leaves DiffusionDrive only 6.7 of its 18.3-point reduction, showing planner targeting.

stated_limitations.value: Only two planners tested, one closed-loop simulator; DiffusionDrive surrogate recall 0.544; single adversarial vehicle, no vulnerable road users; frontal scenarios remain hardest; one escape label per scene.

notes: Adversarial data generation for planner fine-tuning, not user-steerable scenario generation. Family 'other' is a judgement call.
